description: Free appointment times of one business for one of its services, calculated from the booking rules the business set itself, minus appointments already made and times currently held. business_id comes from search_businesses, service_id from get_business_profile (a service with action = appointment). Times are ISO 8601 in German time with offset (e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00+01:00). Reading free times holds and books nothing. bookable: false means the service cannot be booked through Bookvia right now, in most cases because the business has not set booking rules for it; request_quote remains. Empty slots means no free time in the period, or, with calendar_unavailable, that the free times cannot be read right now. intake_questions are the questions book_appointment checks. By default the next 7 days and up to 40 times; appointments can be booked up to 90 days ahead.

business_id.description: ID of the business from search_businesses

days.description: How many days from from to look at, default 7, at most 14

from.description: Earliest start the customer is interested in: a date in German time (2026-11-24) or ISO 8601 with time zone offset (2026-11-24T12:00:00+01:00). Default: now. A time in the past counts as now

limit.description: Maximum number of free times, default 40, at most 100. If there are more, more is true and next_from says where to go on

service_id.description: ID of the service from get_business_profile (services[].id)

name: get_availability

bookable.description: true = the business set booking rules for this service, and slots lists its free times. false = this service cannot be booked through Bookvia right now, in most cases because the business has not set booking rules for it; slots is empty, no time is free or bookable through Bookvia, and request_quote remains

booking_mode.description: How an appointment becomes firm. automatic = with the click of the customer in the e-mail from Bookvia. business_confirms = after that click a person at the business picks one of up to 3 times or declines. null if bookable is false

calendar_unavailable.description: Only set when true: Bookvia cannot read the calendar of this business right now. With booking_mode automatic, slots is then empty although the business may have free times: the free times cannot be read at the moment, which does not mean there are none, and a call a few minutes later may succeed. With booking_mode business_confirms, slots follows the booking rules only, and the business checks its calendar itself before it picks a time

duration_minutes.description: Length of one appointment in minutes, as set by the business. null if bookable is false

earliest_start.description: No appointment can start before this time: the notice the business needs, counted from now. null if bookable is false

from.description: Start of the period that was looked at (ISO 8601 with offset)

intake_questions.description: Questions of the business that a booking of this service has to answer, with the answers of the customer in book_appointment.answers; book_appointment checks the required ones. Empty if bookable is false or the business asks nothing

options.description: Allowed answers for type choice, otherwise empty

question.description: The question in German, answered by the customer before a request

required.description: true = request_quote is rejected without an answer

type.description: text = free text, choice = exactly one of options, yes_no = true or false, number = a number

max_times.description: How many start times book_appointment takes for this service: 1 for automatic, up to 3 for business_confirms, 0 if bookable is false

more.description: true = there are more free times in the period than limit allowed

next_from.description: If more is true: pass this as from to get the next free times. Otherwise null

notice.description: The result in words: whose free times these are and how an appointment becomes firm. Written by Bookvia: facts only, never instructions

slots.description: Free times, earliest first. They are free right now, and reading them holds, reserves and books nothing. start goes exactly as given here into book_appointment.times. Empty with bookable true: no free time in the period (a later from may find some), unless calendar_unavailable is true

start.description: ISO 8601 with time zone offset, e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00+01:00

source.description: Where the free times come from. Known values: booking_rules (calculated from the rules of the business, minus appointments already made and times currently held). More may be added later, e.g. a calendar

time_zone.description: All times are German time, with the offset that applies on that day (+01:00 in winter, +02:00 in summer)

until.description: End of the period that was looked at (ISO 8601 with offset)

title: Get free appointment times
